goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: An existing owner-authorized manifest is safely reusable. The completed Phase 0 worktree and five completed Phase 2 worktrees hold byte-identical ignored manifests; each has exactly the two expected fields, references existing regular source/lock files, and resolves four unique confined resources whose recorded digests match. The aggregate worktree alone lacks the manifest. Approve one replacement Worker that restores the Phase 0 manifest byte-for-byte as an ignored regular local file, validates it without printing values, and then executes the complete unchanged T002 proof vertical. No corpus expansion, private copying, product behavior, dependency, or Phase 4 work is authorized.

evidence.proof: The completed Phase 0 worktree contains an ignored regular manifest previously accepted by completed private-import, visual, receipt, ignore, and sensitive-content gates.
Six completed Phase 0/2 worktrees contain byte-identical manifests with identical referenced source and resource-lock digests; the primary and Phase 3 worktrees do not contain one.

Each reusable manifest has exactly sourcePath and resourceLockPath string fields; both targets are existing regular files. The lock resolves four unique resources confined beneath its lock directory, and every recorded resource digest matches current bytes.

Repository policy ignores .private-corpus/, .motion/, and artifacts/; the tracked inventory contains none of those paths. Prior reuse receipts report zero sensitive findings and no copied private source or resources.
